label: R-47X / 6x6 Unmanned Reconnaissance Rover with Graduated & Localized Damage (D0–D3), 8 Gimbaled Thrusters & Onboard Telemetry

coordinate_system.lateral_convention: -X is rover left flank (appears on screen-right from -Z rear chase camera); +X is rover right flank (appears on screen-left from -Z rear chase camera).

D0.label: Intact
D0.summary: Clean nominal chassis, intact wheel fenders, true 6x6 wheel geometry, straight 8 thruster bells, upright sensor mast, uncracked display covers.

D1.label: Battered
D1.summary: Dented/bent nose and flank armor plates, scuffed titanium edges, and cracked display protective covers (DISPLAY_CRACK_OVERLAY). Full articulation preserved.

D2.label: Component Damage
D2.summary: Visibly buckled wheel cover & suspension arm, flat-spotted/cambered tire, bent/crimped nozzle bell, tilted sensor head with exposed internals, and optional COPV manifold cold-gas leak.

D3.label: Disabled Wreck
D3.summary: Collapsed suspension/axle posture, sheared/missing hull & fender panels, crushed nozzle bells, snapped sensor mast, and 6 bounded detachable debris fragments.

damage_zones.label: Left Flank & COPV Bay (-X · Screen-Right from Rear)
Right Flank & COPV Bay (+X · Screen-Left from Rear)

localized_presets.label: Whole Rover — D2 Component Damage + Gas Leak
Whole Rover — D3 Disabled Wreck + Debris
Localized — Left Flank COPV Breach (-X / Chase-Right)

lod_selection.detailed: Close inspection, localized damage zone swapping, suspension/thruster engineering cutaways and cinematic recordings
lod_selection.distance: Static merged rest pose per damage state (D0–D3) with one material and one draw call. Swap to LOD1 before spinning wheels, steering, articulating suspension, rotating sensor mast, swapping localized zones, or firing cold-gas thrusters.

onboard_displays.location: Left rear wheel cover (-X side; screen-right from -Z rear chase camera)
Right rear wheel cover (+X side; screen-left from -Z rear chase camera)
Rear dorsal black panel (NASM Apollo FDAI-inspired codified yaw/pitch/roll rate & height/level indicator)

runtime.scope: No baked vehicle movement. Supports whole-rover D0–D3 exports across LOD0–LOD2 AND zero-reload in-place localized zone swapping (applyLocalizedDamage) across 19 addressable zones, optional bounded D2 cold-gas COPV leak plumes, 6 detachable D3 debris fragments with convex collision proxies, and 4 UV-mapped onboard telemetry displays with separate crack overlays.
